data.name: Azimat
data.gender_notes: Azimat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azimat is an Arabic name that signifies grandeur, majesty, and reverence. It is a name that evokes feelings of awe and admiration. The name Azimat carries the meaning “Great, Exalted, Magnificent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azimat usually hope their child will grow to embody great, exalted, magnificent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Azimat is associated with the concept of Tawhid, or the oneness of God, emphasizing the greatness and uniqueness of Allah.
data.etymology: Azimat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great, Exalted, Magnificent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azimat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
